title: The Good Guys: 20% Uncapped Cashback (Exclusions Apply, See Terms) @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: The Good Guys: 20% Uncapped Cashback (Exclusions Apply, See Terms) @ TopCashback AU

[tightarse] Been the same exclusions for years with The Good Guys. Nothing we can do about it unfortunately.
[Trishool] Yeah it's the standard list of exclusions for TGG.
[dbglt] Does this work on a price reduced by price beat guarantee? (The automatic one on the web form)
[I Smell Pennies] For those asking about PRICE BEAT, found this comment from TA
Hi. Unfortunately there's no official stance or terms around this from TGGs. What I can tell you (off the record) is that I've used it and it's worked for me and was paid out just fine. The important thing to remember is not to leave the site and not to negotiate externally (this will fail). Give it a go and if it tracks, you'll be ok. If it doesn't track, you've likely done something wrong. Sorry I can't offer more than this, and YMMV. Good luck!
[Reticent] The price beat adds a coupon to the checkout with the amount deducted so I wouldn’t be so sure considering it’s a “coupon code” that’s not in their website.
Hard to say though and I wouldn’t be confident.

Say I am buying a $1000 TV and by clicking price beat gives me $50 discount does that mean the cashback is calculated as a $950 purchase?

I'm not sure if this has come up as a discussion before but the ex GST thing isn't entirely kosher. Sure you can calculate it however you like but if 20% is literally unobtainable then it shouldn't be presented as such - when you can simply and accurately headline it 18% instead.
[Tanvry] It's more of a retailer issue, Temu or Aliexpress track even less than if you ignore GST, and platforms like everyday market / woolworths / coles track the full amount which is quite a surprise

Now can’t login, support but response.

[tightarse] Hi. I can assure you TopCashback is not a scam. It’s a legitimate cashback platform with many millions of members worldwide, and we take the security and integrity of our service extremely seriously.
To protect us, our retailers, and our members, we have a dedicated fraud prevention team responsible for investigating suspicious account activity and potential breaches of our Terms of Service.
The fact you may have accumulated cashback is irrelevant, as accounts are not closed arbitrarily or without reason. Any decision to restrict or terminate accounts is made following a thorough investigation and assessment of data.
If you believe your account was closed in error, reach out to me directly and I’ll do my best to help.
Thanks. TA.
